run_codegen: run the protoc code generator to produce Python and gRPC stubs from route_guide.proto
run_protoc_grpc_python: run protoc with the gRPC Python plugin to compile route_guide.proto into Python stubs
generate_grpc_stubs: generate Python gRPC client and server stubs from the route_guide.proto definition file
generate_python_proto: generate Python message classes from the route_guide.proto file using protoc
review_codegen_script: review the run_codegen.py script that invokes protoc to generate gRPC Python code
